Today, our strength is built on practical engineering, in-house manufacturing capability, continuous R&D and field-tested deployment experience. We remain committed to building a better-connected Malaysia through safe, customisable, cost-effective and reliable telecommunication infrastructure.

Jitrapadu Engineering Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian telecommunication engineering and steel fabrication company specialising in turnkey infrastructure solutions. Our core focus includes telecommunication towers, monopoles, smart poles, lamp poles, rapid deployment systems, portable BTS solutions, custom steel fabrication, project management and technical support. Over the years, Jitrapadu has grown from a steel structure and tower fabrication specialist into a one-stop solution partner for the telecommunications ecosystem. Our work supports telcos, tower owners, infrastructure providers, government-linked organisations and project partners that need reliable structures for network expansion, 5G rollout, smart city development and rural connectivity.
To become Malaysia’s trusted leader in telecommunication steel infrastructure by driving innovation, safety and sustainable connectivity for the future.
To provide customisable, cost-effective and reliable telecommunication infrastructure solutions through engineering excellence, in-house fabrication, continuous R&D and professional project delivery.

Jitrapadu designs and fabricates telecommunication towers and monopoles for diverse deployment needs, from rural coverage to high-capacity urban sites. Our structures are engineered for strength, durability and long-term performance across Malaysia’s climate and terrain conditions. We support tower owners, telcos, infrastructure providers and project partners with solutions that can be tailored by height, load capacity, operator requirements, foundation type and site constraints. With in-house fabrication and experienced project teams, we help clients move from engineering concept to field deployment with greater confidence.
Jitrapadu has worked with telecommunication providers, infrastructure owners, public sector organisations and industry partners across Malaysia and beyond.

Our telecom tower and monopole solutions are suitable for new network rollout, capacity expansion, infrastructure sharing and specialised communication needs.
What types of telecommunication towers does Jitrapadu provide?
We provide angular towers, 3-legged towers, 4-legged towers, monopoles, rooftop unipoles, guyed masts and customised tower structures.
What height range is available for angular towers?
Our angular towers can range from 30m to 120m, depending on site requirements, load category and project specifications.
How many operators can a monopole support?
Our monopoles can be designed for multi-telco installations. Based on the provided company profile, selected monopole designs can support up to six telecommunication operators.
Yes. Core steel fabrication is handled through Jitrapadu’s in-house manufacturing facility in Klang, giving better control over quality and delivery.
What standards do your structures follow?
Structures are designed to comply with recognised standards such as BS 5950, BS 6399, BS 8100 and TIA-222-G, depending on project requirements.
We begin by reviewing the client’s coverage objective, site location, operator load, required height, timeline and access conditions.
Our team evaluates the site constraints, available footprint, terrain, wind exposure, foundation requirements and surrounding environment.
The tower or monopole is designed according to the required height, loading category, telco-sharing capacity and applicable structural standards.
We prepare a practical solution with technical recommendations, estimated cost, fabrication timeline and deployment approach.
Approved designs move into fabrication at our Klang facility, where steel components are cut, formed, welded and prepared for finishing.
Steel members are finished according to project specifications, including galvanising and aviation-related coating where required.
Depending on the structure type, the site is prepared for conventional concrete foundation or RDS-compatible footing solutions.
Fabricated components are delivered to site and erected by qualified teams, with safety and alignment checked throughout the process.
We coordinate with relevant telco or equipment teams for antenna, cabinet, cable and supporting infrastructure installation.
Final checks are carried out before handover, with technical support available for maintenance, optimisation or future upgrades.

In-house Steel Fabrication Capability, from Factory to Field

Jitrapadu’s factory in Jalan Kapar, Klang, is a key part of our strength as a telecommunication infrastructure partner. With in-house fabrication capability, we are able to manage quality, production timelines and technical requirements more closely from the beginning of each project. Our facility supports the manufacturing of towers, monopoles, smart poles, lamp poles, RDS structures and custom steel solutions. By combining engineering, fabrication and project execution under one coordinated process, we help clients move from design to deployment with fewer gaps and better accountability.
Our factory is located in Jalan Kapar, Klang, with a covered facility of approximately 79,800 sq. ft.

From engineering design to fabrication and installation, our process is built around safety, reliability and long-term structural performance.
